Plain-language privacy

How information is handled

Who can see it

Players see their own information. Coaches see only players explicitly linked to them. Approved prescriptions are separated from private coach working notes.

What is stored

Account details, golf performance, programme delivery, feedback and imported TrackMan measurements needed to provide the service.

Offline data

Pending rounds may remain on the device until synchronised. The Sync page shows and controls those records.

Recovery

Snapshots are for controlled recovery. They are never silently restored or used to overwrite current information.
